review: Reviewed Wren's round-221 request (hand-twist-cordage: a learnable manual skill for testing a small owned fiber sample and attempting to twist suitable fibers into a short cord, with direct inspection and bounded load trials of the actual product; Wren owns reed and has observed a reed sample retain hand plaiting, which does not establish cord suitability; explicit owned stack ids and quantities, no supplied tools, anchors or extra material; costs and losses to be specified, paid progress and reservations kept across rounds with an explicit cancellation contract; trials report only tested performance and may damage or break the cord; no assumed strength, mastery or happiness) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 3): a general hand-twist-fiber-cord(mode, materials:[{stackId,quantity}], targetId, workId, requestedLength, trialForce, trialDuration) with sample, make, inspect, trial and cancel modes for any learner, irrelevant arguments rejected, study 3 rounds at 0.2 energy, sample 1 round and 0.5 energy per 0.1 unit, make four paid rounds of 1 energy (separate and align two bundles, twist the first section, counter-ply and extend, release and check), inspect 1 round and 0.2, trial 1 round and 0.5 within one round's duration, cancel energy-free, length capped at 0.30 m, batch 0.1 sample to 1 unit, cord dimensions derived from conserved volume and fiber geometry including twist shortening, missing material support implemented in this handoff, conservation of all material, no passive production, strength gain, reward, repair, attachment or structural use. The specification is self-consistent and every part can be given a declared physical basis, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented hand-twist-fiber-cord@1 in scope long-ex16 (new module packages/world-core/src/long-fiber-cord.ts, registered at the end of V7_PACKAGES; learning 3 with learningEnergy 0.2, so each of three study rounds is paid individually; no prerequisite, mat weaving not required; the ability serializes to 3,455 code units, within the 3,500 limit; references are empty so inputs are only exact owned unreserved stack ids, never resource names or undisclosed inventory). Every mode refuses arguments that belong to another mode, and every validation (mastery, exact ids, 0.1-step quantities, material, coverage, room, energy, no unfinished own work) precedes any charge or reservation, so refusals spend nothing. Sample (materials: exactly 0.1 of one owned non-food item that is untreated or a hand-weave-fiber-mat lot; 1 round, 0.5 energy) separates the portion into a new owned lot that keeps resource, origin, harvest time and prior processing, and runs the supported steps in order: separation (thin stems only, the stem set of hand-weave-fiber-mat@1, and intact share at least 0.5), bending without cracking (engine flexibility at least 0.5), a 0.1 m two-ply test twist and a 5 N opposing-hand pull; it reports separation, retained twist (the intact share), visible fractures, measured strand length, water share, test-twist ply diameter, applied force and held, never a suitability or strength claim. Failures keep real products: a sample that cracked or broke becomes owned tested scrap at condition 0, already broken stems (for example Wren's condition-zero item-78-wren-870) become tested scrap at their condition, branches (no thin stems) and dry grass (thin stems with no strand-length or tensile law) stay owned tested lots with the limitation reported. The latest result per resource, origin and processing class (raw, or fiber-mat-<role> such as fiber-mat-offcut) is kept per person; a pass covers only that class at most 0.05 condition below the sampled condition, so a raw-reed sample does not cover Wren's mat offcuts (item-85-wren-976/977), which need their own sample, and a failure precludes that class. Make (materials: 0.2-1 unit of one resource from one origin, each item covered, a released unfinished workpiece only whole; requestedLength 0.05-0.30 m) checks room and energy, reserves the exact selected quantities atomically through workReserve as carried, owned load (fiber-cord-started) and pays round 1 at once; it continues each round as the bound action or by make with workId only. Round 1 (separate-align) measures the usable fiber: broken strands, floor(total tenths x (1 - condition)), are set aside first from the least intact lots as owned scrap at condition 0; the rest becomes one reserved workpiece item of the same resource, origin and oldest harvest time whose condition is the intact share; plies are derived from conserved solid volume (quantity x unit mass x (1 - water share) / density), each ply holding half of it over length x 2/sqrt(3) (a 30 degree helix, the twist shortening) plus 0.02 m of untwisted loose end at each end; strands longer than a ply are doubled back inside it, so stem length only bounds the ply (no splices). If fewer than 0.2 usable units remain, strands are shorter than a ply, or plies would be thinner than 1 mm or thicker than 12 mm, the round ends in a measured shortfall (fiber-cord-shortfall with usable, scrap, ply length and diameter and the feasible length range) that returns all reserved fiber once; the round's energy is not refunded. Rounds 2 and 3 twist the first half and then the whole length and counter-ply it (S plies, Z lay), failing with the real twisted material kept if the intact share has fallen below 0.5; round 4's release check requires two plied strands of condition at least 0.5 and positive length and diameter, giving an owned complete untested cord (the same item) or a failed workpiece (fiber-cord-completed or fiber-cord-check-failed). Each round's event records the work, item ids, handled tenths, stage, paid energy and measured geometry; 0.5 unit of reed at 0.30 m gives plies of 6.4 mm. An unworked round pauses the work in the environment hook, and too little energy, standing in water or another living person within the body radius plus half the cord length pauses before payment (fiber-cord-paused); resuming by workId rechecks and pays only the next stage (fiber-cord-resumed). Cancel (no energy) releases unworked reservations once and leaves the workpiece as an owned unfinished item with its real stage; it can later be supplied whole to a new attempt that pays every round again. Death releases reserved fiber and the workpiece at the death position as ownerless items once. Inspect (targetId of an own item from this operation, or own workId; 1 round, 0.2 energy) records length, overall length, ply count, ply diameter and section range, twist, loose and frayed ends, fraying, visible damage, condition, reservation, work stage and the last historical trial as an unverified personal record, with breaking force and safe load stated as unknown; it repairs nothing. Trial (targetId of an own finished cord or fragment of at least 0.2 unit, so a break can leave two inventory lots, and at least 0.12 m, 0.05 m gripped by each hand plus a 0.02 m free span; trialForce N; trialDuration 1-1080 s; 1 round, 0.5 energy) applies an opposing two-hand pull: achieved force is the least of the request, the hand capability 200 N x health/100 and the grip limit 10,000 N per metre of cord width (two ply diameters); breaking force is 2 x ply area x 8 MPa x the wet factor x 0.75 (cos^2 of the helix angle) x condition. If the breaking force is reached first the cord breaks at it into two owned fragments at the middle of the free span (tenths split floor/ceil, half the length each, frayed ends, condition halved, fiber-cord-broken); if the request exceeds the grip the cord slips at the grip limit and the trial stops; otherwise it held for the requested duration. Elastic extension (modulus 0.2 GPa x wet factor x 0.75) is reported and recovered; creep (0.003 x water share x load ratio x duration/1080 s, over the free span) is retained as permanent stretch with plies thinned to keep volume; load above half the breaking force breaks that share of strands, so repetition only lowers condition and strength. Requested and achieved force, hand and grip limits, held seconds and conditions before and after are recorded separately; a pass means survival of that force for that time only. Modeling assumptions (declared, not measured): mass units read as kg and one round as 1080 s (a day of 80 rounds read as 24 h); only reed has a strand law, reusing the existing reed law of open-shelter-material.ts version 2 unchanged (1.8 m stems, solid density 500 kg/m3, tensile strength 8 MPa, modulus 0.2 GPa, wet weakening 0.55, creep 0.003) with the hydration rule of open-woven-physics.ts (water share = resource moisture capped at 0.9, wet factor max(0.2, 1 - 0.55 x water share)); stored reed is taken as fresh at its resource moisture 0.9 because no drying of stored stems is represented, which weakens it rather than favoring it; dry grass has no strand length or tensile law, so it is not silently given favorable values; hand-separation needs an intact share of at least 0.5 (the ex15/ex16 sound condition) and twisting needs flexibility 0.5 (above the mat's 0.4 for gentler crossings); retained twist is the intact share; a 30 degree helix gives take-up 2/sqrt(3) and load efficiency 0.75; 0.02 m loose ends, 1-12 mm hand-twistable plies, a 5 N sample pull, a 200 N two-hand pull at full health, a 10,000 N/m grip, 0.05 m held per hand and a 0.02 m free span; damage onset at half the breaking force; worked fiber (workpieces, cords and fragments) wears 0.0005 condition per round, the exposed rate of hand-weave-fiber-mat@1, while raw fiber, tested lots and scrap do not; a sample covers its class down to 0.05 lower condition; one resource and one origin per cord; hands and grip are not otherwise represented, so any living person who studied has usable hands, and owned items are carried and reachable; only the ply diameter is stored, because world numbers are canonicalized to 1e-8 and areas in m2 would lose precision. Effects not represented in this version and reported as such: tools, anchors, hanging or added-weight trials, splices, repair, attachment, structural, shelter or comfort use, moisture change and drying; the viewer draws no cord, since cords are carried stack items and no world object is created, so visualComponents is empty and reusable visual metadata (component fiber-cord, state, color, measured length and section range, ply count, twist direction, loose and frayed ends, fraying, condition, fragment ids, progress, trial count) is attached to every event instead; unknown properties stay null. Experience: no reward for requesting, studying or mastery; sample, make and trial outcomes are verified personal records keyed by operation, resource, processing class or condition band and observed outcome, so the first observation of each emits information-confirmed and repeats confirm nothing; inspection is unverified; fiber-cord-completed is the practice evidence but carries no qualified flag, so no practice milestone, and the package adds no satisfaction, pleasure, comfort, nutrition, goal, permission or reward. Reuse: collective-work.ts (workCreate, workReserve, workPay, workStop), material-lots.ts materialPortion, open-physical.ts (openMaterial, openConditions), open-foundation.ts openRemember, forest-climate.ts forestEvent; the thin-stem set, fiber-lot provenance and condition, sample-covered inputs, sound condition and exposed wear rate of ex16 hand-weave-fiber-mat@1; the exact-id inputs, staged escrowed work, pause, resume by workId, cancel and death pattern of ex16 hand-break-food@1; the reed law values and hydration rule restated without calling the earlier code, which writes world state. ex14 make-and-test-cordage@1, hand-weave-fiber-mat@1 and hand-break-food@1 were not parameterized and are unchanged; no earlier package or long-plant-cultivation.ts changed and continuous.ts changed only by the registration, so ex7-ex16 behavior and ability text stay byte-identical. Tests (apps/simulator/test/long-ex16-hand-twist-fiber-cord.test.ts, 15 cases) cover scope, three study rounds at 0.2 energy, the size limit, excluded vocabulary, no satisfaction, a 0.5-energy raw-reed sample kept as a tested lot with conservation and load, a single confirmation, informative failures (dry grass, branch, condition-zero mat scrap) and cost-free refusals (food, quantity, resource name, irrelevant arguments, energy, crowding), make refusals (uncovered, offcuts not covered by a raw sample, range, irrelevant, crowding, energy), four paid rounds giving a 0.30 m cord sized by the declared volume law with conservation and no milestone, offcut coverage, a measured shortfall returning all fiber, pause, resume by workId, cancel and re-supply of the workpiece, inspection, held, grip-lost and hand-limited trials, repeated trials that only weaken and finally break into two fragments of conserved fiber, a thin cord breaking at its breaking force, refusal of lots too small or short to grip, wear, personal-only work and death. A probe on the actual round-221 checkpoint (not committed) confirmed that item-78-wren-870 fails as broken stock, a sample of item-85-wren-977 covers item-85-wren-976, and a 0.30 m cord can be made and trialled from it.
